$comment: Opaque baseline for the reachable-history secret scan.
Consumed by scripts/security/historyScanBaseline.mjs. This file is NOT a scanner
allowlist: the scanner still detects every finding, and the reconciler accounts for
all of them against the digests below. Detection visibility is preserved on purpose.
Every value here is a SHA-256 digest of something that must be independently
re-derived from the scan at verification time. The file therefore carries no path,
commit, detector name or other descriptive metadata, and it cannot be widened by
editing a string: a digest that does not match re-derived input simply fails.
An entry is non-blocking only when its status is verified-inactive AND it carries a
recognised evidenceClass and an evidenceDigest. Detailed supporting evidence is
